name: Farrell Dalsing
headline: Senior Product Manager | Strategic Platform & Client Product Leadership | Hospitality & Travel Tech | Driving Scalable Booking & Revenue Experiences
text:
I had the pleasure of working with Raul at iSeatz, where he served as a contract Senior Backend Elixir Engineer on one of the development teams I led as Senior Product Manager, supporting the American Express Travel hotel booking platform.

Raul is an exceptional engineer who combines technical expertise, intellectual curiosity, thoughtful problem-solving, and remarkable autonomy with a genuine commitment to collaboration and quality.

One of the things I appreciated most about Raul was his ability to tackle complex assignments, even when business requirements were evolving or the technical approach was unclear. He patiently explored possibilities, investigated dependencies, collaborated with peers and architects, and developed thoughtful, scalable solutions.

Raul also understood that great engineering extends beyond writing excellent code. He worked closely with our Business Analysts to refine stories and establish clear acceptance criteria, making work easier for fellow developers and QA engineers. His outstanding documentation of complex data sources and flows continues to be a valuable resource for the team.

As a Product Manager and client liaison, I especially valued Raul's ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and patiently. His insights and willingness to help strengthened my own effectiveness and confidence in communicating with our client.

Beyond his technical contributions, Raul is simply a wonderful teammate—kind, thoughtful, dependable, and generous with his knowledge.

I wholeheartedly recommend Raul to any organization seeking an outstanding Senior Elixir Engineer. He elevates the quality of the work and the people around him, and I would welcome the opportunity to work with him again!

text: I had the pleasure of teaching Raúl, who was an excellent student. I particularly appreciated his kindness, excellent communication, and consistently positive attitude. name: Valeriia Maliarenko
headline: Middle Business Analyst at DataArt
text:
I really enjoyed working with Raul. He is an attentive and proactive technical specialist who thinks creatively and independently and takes a thoughtful approach to investigating potential solutions.

As a Business Analyst, I particularly appreciated how thoroughly he investigated different options and how patiently he explained technical details to non-technical team members. He was always willing to help, whether it meant jumping on an urgent task or supporting other developers. He is also open to feedback and thoughtful about incorporating it into his work.

Raul is a great communicator who builds positive working relationships, including with client representatives. Beyond his technical expertise, he is a genuinely kind and approachable person who makes collaboration enjoyable.

I'd gladly recommend Raul to any team looking for a skilled, proactive, and collaborative technical specialist.

name: Gerson Scanapieco
headline: Engineering | Backend Focused
text: Working with Raul was an excellent experience. He has great technical skills and is a great team player, always striving to deliver great results. I highly recommend him, and look forward to work with him again.
